SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-07-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO JUL-07-2021 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF GREGGORY JOHNSON IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT DELL TECHNOLOGIES INCORPORATED, REPRESENTED BY KAREN THRO, LEGAL ASSISTANT, LIVINGSTON LAW FIRM, IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT, DELL TECHNOLOGIES IS ORDERED TO SEND PLAINTIFF, BY FEDERAL EXPRESS, A NEW (NOT REFURBISHED) G7 COMPUTER WITH THE SAME SPECIFICATION AS THE DEFECTIVE G7 WHICH IS STILL IN PLAINTIFF'S POSSESSION. DEFENDANT IS TO PROVIDE SPECIFIC INSTRUCTION ON HOW TO RETURN THE COMPUTER STILL IN PLAINTIFFS' POSSESSION. A PROGRESS REPORT DATE HAS BEEN SET FOR JULY 7, 2021, AT 1:30 P.M. IF NO APPEARANCE THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
ORDER RE: CONTINUANCE FOR PROGRESS REPORT. MATTER CONTINUED TO JULY 7, 2021 AT 1:30 P.M. DEPT. 506. IF NO APPEARANCE THE MATTER WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT)

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-07-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO JUL-28-2021 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. (FILE RETAINED IN COURTROOM) PLAINTIFF GREGGORY JOHNSON IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT DELL TECHNOLOGIES INCORPORTED, REPRESENTED BY KAREN THRO, IS PRESENT. REPRESENTATIVE FOR DEFENDANT FOR DELL TECHNOLOGIES INCORPORATED, KAREN THRO, STATES THAT DELL TECHNOLOGIES IS WORKING ON FINALIZING PLAINTIFF'S NEW G7 COMPUTER WITH THE SYSTEM UPGRADES AND THE ESTIMATED DELIVERY DATE IS JULY 15, 2021. MS. THRO STATES THAT A NEW 1 YEAR WARRANTY IS INCLUDED ON PLAINTIFF'S NEW COMPUTER. A FINAL PROGRESS REPORT DATE IS SET. IF DEFENDANT DELL TECHNOLOGIES INC. DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE COURT'S ORDER, PUNITIVE DAMAGES WILL BE ASSESSED AT THE NEXT HEARING. APPEARANCES ARE REQUIRED IF TERMS OF THE AGREEMENT HAVE NOT BEEN MET AND PLAINTIFF HAS NOT RECEIVED HIS NEW COMPUTER BY THE ESTIMATED DATE OF DELIVERY. IF THERE ARE NO APPEARANCES, THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-28-2021 - JUDGMENT. COURT DISCLOSURE IS GIVEN. PLAINTIFF GREGGORY JOHNSON IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT DELL TECHNOLOGIES INCORPORTED, REPRESENTED BY KAREN THRO, PARALEGAL IS PRESENT.COURT IS SATISFIED THE DELAY OF THE DELL IS NOW SCHEDULED FOR AUGUST 3, 2021. THE JUDGMENT AWARD IS FOR THE COMPUTER RENTAL. COSTS INCURRED BY THE PLAINTIFF WHILE WAITING FOR THE NEW COMPUTER. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF JOHNSON, GREGGORY RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT DELL TECHNOLOGIES INCORPORATED, A DELAWARE CORP $2,286.00 PRINCIPAL, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,286.00, COURT IS SATISFIED THE DELAY OF THE DELL IS NOW SCHEDULED FOR AUGUST 3, 2021. THE JUDGMENT AWARD IS FOR THE COMPUTER RENTAL. COST INCURRED BY THE PLAINTIFF WHILE WAITING FOR THE NEW COMPUTER. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
